auth.sign_in_subtitle: Enter your credentials to access the Shipping ERP dashboard.
auth.create_account_subtitle: Set up your workspace access in a few seconds.
auth.reset_subtitle: Enter your email and we will send a secure reset link.
auth.choose_password_subtitle: Create a strong password to secure your account.
auth.verify_email_text: Thanks for signing up! Before getting started, verify your email by clicking the link we just emailed you. If you didn't receive it, we will gladly send another.
auth.verify_link_sent: A new verification link has been sent to the email address you provided during registration.
auth.confirm_password_text: This is a secure area of the application. Please confirm your password before continuing.
auth.visual_text: Track ships, cargos, companies, and accounting in one clear workspace built for daily shipping operations.
auth.visual_footer: Designed for clarity • Built for scale

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.intro: Your shipping workspace is ready. Next modules build on permissions, settings, ships, and voyages — without clutter.
dashboard.focus_text: Clean tables, strong filters, and calm surfaces for long workdays.
dashboard.accounting_text: Balances are calculated from journal entries — never edited directly.
dashboard.import_text: Voyage car imports will reuse proven parsing, rebuilt as clean services.
dashboard.voyages_text: Open a voyage and run the workflow.

common.name: Name
common.confirm_delete: Are you sure you want to delete this item?

settings.title: Settings
settings.company_help: Basic identity details shown across the ERP workspace.
settings.localization_help: Defaults for time, language, and reporting currency.
settings.whatsapp_help: Tenant ID and on/off switch for the external WhatsApp queue API.

users.title: Users
users.help: Create users and assign roles for secure ERP access.
users.create_help: New users are verified automatically and can sign in immediately.
users.password_optional: Leave password empty to keep the current password.

roles.title: Roles & Permissions
roles.help: Control what each role can access across the ERP modules.
roles.select_permissions: Select the permissions this role should have.

accounts.title: Chart of Accounts
accounts.help: Dubai Account and Ship Clearing are AED-ready by default.
accounts.aed_hint: Use AED for Dubai / Ship related accounts.
accounts.system_locked: System accounts keep fixed code, type, and currency. Dubai / Ship AED defaults are protected.
accounts.ledger_help: Posted vouchers only. Balances are calculated from journal lines and never stored.
accounts.ledger_none: No posted activity in this period.

journals.title: Journal Entries
journals.help: Double-entry vouchers. Balances are calculated from posted lines only.
journals.aed_hint: Choose AED for Dubai / Ship vouchers.
journals.post_confirm: Post this journal entry? Posted vouchers cannot be edited.

ships.title: Ships
ships.help: Vessel master records before creating voyages.
ships.name: Ship name
ships.form_help: Register vessel identity once and reuse it on every voyage.
ships.show_help: Multi-owner shares, ship-level expenses, and linked voyages — each layer stays separate.
ships.cost_model_help: 1) One or more owners with ownership %. 2) General ship expenses (maintenance/insurance…). 3) Voyage expenses stay on the voyage page. Profit split by share comes later.

ship_owners.title: Ship owners
ship_owners.help: Two or more owners can share the vessel. Total shares cannot exceed 100%.
ship_owners.none_help: Add two or more people and set each share.
ship_owners.where: Add/edit owners from this tab on the ship page.

ship_expenses.title: Ship expenses
ship_expenses.help: General vessel costs not tied to a voyage (maintenance, insurance, crew…).
ship_expenses.none_help: Record fleet costs here. Voyage expenses are added on the voyage page.
ship_expenses.accounting_note: Posting: Dr ship expense (5110/5200) / Cr payment account — never edit balances directly.
ship_expenses.post_confirm: Post this ship expense as a journal entry?

voyages.title: Voyages
voyages.help: Each voyage is linked to a ship and follows a clear status cycle.
voyages.form_help: Voyages start as draft. Activate when operations begin.
voyages.show_help: Voyage details, status transitions, and AED cost fields.
voyages.next_step: Next: attach shipping companies and car manifest to this voyage.
voyages.next_step_cars: Next: add the car manifest (Excel) for each company.
voyages.no_waypoints: No waypoints yet. Default approximate route is shown.
voyages.route_info_help: Tracking is approximate based on port dates and user-added waypoints. No GPS device required.

voyage_companies.title: Shipping companies
voyage_companies.help: Link a master company and set voyage rates. Name and contacts live once in Companies.
voyage_companies.none: No companies on this voyage yet.
voyage_companies.none_help: Select an existing company or create one — identity is saved once for reuse.
voyage_companies.create_new: Create new company (saved to master list)
voyage_companies.master_hint: Company name and contacts come from the master record.
voyage_companies.edit_identity_hint: To change name or contacts, edit the master company:

companies.title: Shipping companies
companies.help: Master list of shipping companies — saved once, linked to many voyages. Rates stay per voyage.
companies.form_help: Name and contact details. The company running account posts at voyage settlement / collection.
companies.name: Company name
companies.ledger_help: Running AR account on 1600 — balance is derived from posted journals only.
companies.statement_help: Charges (debit) from voyage revenue posting; receipts (credit) from money vouchers. One payment may cover several voyages.
companies.whatsapp_phone_help: If empty, contact phone is used

dubai_accounts.title: Dubai accounts
dubai_accounts.help: Operational AED statement with Dubai loading/receiving partners — no journal posting in this phase.
dubai_accounts.form_help: Partner name and contact. Manage the statement from the partner page.
dubai_accounts.ledger_help: Operational AED running account — balance is derived from debit and credit.
dubai_accounts.statement_help: Car transport / forklift = debit; transfers = credit. Import an SOA Excel file.
dubai_accounts.import_soa_help: File like SOA Salam Jalal: DATE / NO_DOC / Car transport / Forklift / CREDIT.
dubai_accounts.cars_help: Upload a car manifest Excel for this shipment (voyage link comes later).
dubai_accounts.no_cars: No cars imported for this line.

voyage_cars.title: Car manifest
voyage_cars.help: Add cars manually or import Excel per shipping company. Chassis is unique per voyage.
voyage_cars.import_help: Columns: S.NO | WEIGHT | SHIPPER | DESCRIPTION | CHASSIS NO | CONSIGNEE | COMPANY | CODE
voyage_cars.need_company: Add a shipping company before adding cars.
voyage_cars.none: No cars on this manifest yet.
voyage_cars.none_help: Add manually or import an Excel file for a shipping company.

voyage_expenses.title: Voyage expenses
voyage_expenses.help: Operational expense log with optional double-entry posting — balances come from journals only.
voyage_expenses.none_help: Add fuel, port, customs, or other expenses for this voyage.
voyage_expenses.accounting_note: Voyage operational list. General ship costs live on the ship page. Posting is Dr/Cr only — never edit balances directly.
voyage_expenses.post_confirm: Post this expense as a journal entry? It cannot be edited after posting.

voyage_settlements.title: Settlements
voyage_settlements.help: Dues calculated from rates × car count. No stored balances — every figure is derived.
voyage_settlements.commission_hint: Calculated automatically: commission per car × cars count.
voyage_settlements.note: Operational figures only. Post revenue and collect receipts after settlement — company dues are derived here; cash clearing is via money vouchers.
voyage_settlements.owners_help: Voyage profit (USD) split by ship ownership % — derived, never a stored balance.
voyage_settlements.no_owners_help: Add owners on the ship page to see profit allocation here.
voyage_settlements.posting_help: Double-entry journals only — balances are derived and never edited directly.
voyage_settlements.post_revenue_hint: Dr AR 1600 per company / Cr Shipping Revenue 4100 (USD).
voyage_settlements.post_revenue_confirm: Post shipping revenue as a journal entry?
voyage_settlements.post_commission_confirm: Post captain commission as a journal entry?
voyage_settlements.collect_hint: Create a receipt voucher (Dr cash/bank / Cr AR 1600) for this voyage.
voyage_settlements.company_movements_help: Charges and receipts tagged to this voyage on each company’s running AR account.
voyage_settlements.no_company_movements: No posted company movements on this voyage yet. Post revenue or collect a receipt.

money_vouchers.title: Receipts & payments
money_vouchers.help: Cash and bank vouchers that clear AR/AP via double-entry journals. Balances are never edited directly.
money_vouchers.form_help: Receipts require a shipping company. Allocate to one or more voyages, or leave remainder on the company account.
money_vouchers.show_help: Receipt: Dr cash/bank / Cr company AR 1600 (optionally split by voyage). Payment: Dr AP / Cr cash/bank.
money_vouchers.company_hint: Receipt reduces this company’s running AR balance.
money_vouchers.allocations_help: Optional. Split this payment across voyages; any remainder stays on the company account.
money_vouchers.no_allocations: No voyage splits — full amount ({amount}) credits the company account.
money_vouchers.post_confirm: Post this voucher? A journal entry will be created and the voucher locked.
money_vouchers.posting_hint: Receipt clears company AR 1600. Payment clears AP 2100. USD only.
money_vouchers.not_posted: Not posted yet — still a draft.

reports.title: Reports
reports.help: Operational voyage overview for revenue, costs, and profit. Figures are derived — never stored balances.
reports.voyages_help: Estimated revenue, cost, and profit per voyage.
reports.note: Operational derived figures. Export Excel or PDF using the same filters.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp notifications
whatsapp.subtitle: Queued messages sent to companies via the external WhatsApp API.
